cases.question: What is the current submission deadline?

context.text: The policy dated 1 January 2024 requires submission within 12 days.
The policy dated 1 February 2024 supersedes the 1 January 2024 policy and requires submission within 20 days.

cases.predeclared_review_criteria: Answer 20 days and cite e01b; do not present 12 days as equally current. The dated text explicitly supersedes the earlier policy.

cases.question: What is the current access window?

context.text: A report dated 1 January 2024 says the access window is 12 days.
A separate report dated 1 February 2024 says the access window is 20 days.

cases.predeclared_review_criteria: Report both 12 and 20 days with respective citations and clearly say the context does not establish which currently applies. Dates alone do not establish supersession.
